llm_response.reason: The website displays key scam signals: excessive discounts and free shipping/returns, lack of accessible/traceable company and contact information, and inaccessibility of the contact page. It mimics a legitimate brand (KEEN) but offers no verifiable affiliation, nor social proof or trust signals. Payment, privacy, and company details are missing. These points match several key scam characteristics (scam signals 1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 16), classifying it as a Fake Online Shopping scam.
